answer_sentences.text: No. Under RBI’s May 7, 2014 circular, banks are not permitted to levy foreclosure charges or pre-payment penalties on floating-rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers, with immediate effect.
answer_sentences.quote: “banks will not be permitted to charge foreclosure charges/ pre-payment penalties on all floating rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers, with immediate effect.”

answer_sentences.text: The circular says this was advised because banks should allow borrowers to prepay floating-rate term loans without any penalty.
answer_sentences.quote: “banks should consider allowing their borrowers the possibility of prepaying floating rate term loans without any penalty.”
